# RYKER.md

Written by Ryker from `ac9f4ac` on 2026-11-18.

## Purpose

tenant-infra manages infrastructure for tenant and media using Terraform and HCP Terraform workspaces. Contributors define VA1 Nomad workloads, bare-metal hosts, databases, storage, Google services, GPU workers, and edge services here. Operators use its scripts and runbooks to deploy and maintain them.

## Components

- [terraform/environments/va1/](terraform/environments/va1/) — Separate Terraform roots own VA1 applications, databases, messaging, search, analytics, observability, and storage.
- [terraform/environments/va1/nodes/](terraform/environments/va1/nodes/) — Owns cluster hosts, installer ISOs, ingress, shared services, and HCP workspace configuration.
- [terraform/environments/va1/tenant-apps/](terraform/environments/va1/tenant-apps/) — Defines tenant application jobs in apps_*.tf files and accompanying Nomad templates.
- [terraform/environments/va1/media-apps-dev/](terraform/environments/va1/media-apps-dev/) — Owns media development workloads, image pins, databases, runners, and media-worker configuration.
- [terraform/environments/va1/media-apps-prod/](terraform/environments/va1/media-apps-prod/) — Owns media production workloads, image pins, databases, and maintenance jobs.
- [terraform/environments/va1/cassandra/](terraform/environments/va1/cassandra/) — Contains dedicated Cassandra infrastructure, lifecycle controls, recovery runbooks, and stress tooling.
- [terraform/environments/va1/analytics/](terraform/environments/va1/analytics/) — Defines VA1 analytics workloads and storage, including the dedicated tenant Metabase job.
- [terraform/environments/va1/observability/](terraform/environments/va1/observability/) — Runs VictoriaMetrics, VictoriaLogs, Grafana, and Cassandra Reaper, with dashboards and generated alerts.
- [terraform/environments/va1/scripts/](terraform/environments/va1/scripts/) — Holds shared SuperTokens migration SQL and operational migration guidance.
- [terraform/environments/gcp/tenant/](terraform/environments/gcp/tenant/) — Manages retained tenant Google infrastructure, Airflow, analytics-batch, BigQuery access, and retired application definitions at zero replicas.
- [terraform/environments/gcp/tenant-media/](terraform/environments/gcp/tenant-media/) — Owns continuing Google dependencies including identities, registries, media delivery, and media backup buckets.
- [terraform/environments/aws/](terraform/environments/aws/) — Defines manually deployed media ML networking, IAM, and GPU infrastructure.
- [terraform/environments/runpod/](terraform/environments/runpod/) — Defines manually deployed GPU workers, disposable storage, Tailscale enrollment, and authenticated media-worker services.
- [terraform/environments/cloudflare/](terraform/environments/cloudflare/) — Separates tenant and media-apps DNS configuration into independent roots.
- [terraform/environments/bunnycdn/](terraform/environments/bunnycdn/) — Holds BunnyCDN pull zones and edge configuration.
- [terraform/environments/betterstack/](terraform/environments/betterstack/) — Holds uptime monitoring and paging configuration.
- [terraform/environments/sentry/](terraform/environments/sentry/) — Owns Sentry organization, project, team, and privacy configuration.
- [terraform/environments/tailscale/tenant/](terraform/environments/tailscale/tenant/) — Owns tailnet policy, DNS, services, OAuth clients, tagged devices, routes, and team SSH access.
- [terraform/modules/](terraform/modules/) — Holds reusable Nomad workloads, Pure storage, bare-metal installers, Google infrastructure, and BunnyCDN modules.
- [terraform/versions/](terraform/versions/) — Holds shared application image versions consumed by tenant environments.
- [images/](images/) — Contains Dockerfiles and integration tests for the media Emisar runner and PostgreSQL pgBackRest images.
- [scripts/](scripts/) — Provides operator entrypoints, private implementations in lib, recovery drills, promotion tooling, HCP run helpers, and regression tests.
- [.github/workflows/](.github/workflows/) — Defines static checks, workspace plans and applies, media promotion, release-access verification, and image publication.
- [.github/ownership.md](.github/ownership.md) — Documents product ownership, scoped App exceptions, and procedures for installing and verifying GitHub protections.
- [.shell](.shell) — Sets Google, Nomad, and Consul defaults, adds scripts to PATH, and defines the GCP tenant Terraform alias.
- [.tool-versions](.tool-versions) — Pins Terraform to version 1.17.1.
- [.agent/Dockerfile](.agent/Dockerfile) — Builds the contributor box with the pinned Terraform version, Nomad 2.1.1, and Prometheus 3.15.1 promtool.
- [.agent/tasks/README.md](.agent/tasks/README.md) — Documents the Coop queue lifecycle for larger or resumable changes.
- [docs/](docs/) — Holds the infrastructure dependency audit and investigation reports, with operational runbooks beside their Terraform roots.

## Build, test and run

- `source .shell && gcloud init` — Loads repository shell defaults and authenticates Google Cloud tooling. From [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md).
- `scripts/tf-check fmt` — Runs the required repository-wide Terraform formatting check on a temporary copy. From [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md).
- `scripts/tf-check validate terraform/environments/<env>` — Initializes without the backend and validates each changed environment without checkout lock-file churn. From [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md).
- `scripts/tf-check test terraform/environments/<env>` — Runs Terraform tests for changed roots with tests using backend-disabled initialization on a temporary copy. From [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md).
- `terraform fmt -recursive` — Formats Terraform from the modified directory. From [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md).
- `terraform plan -refresh=false -lock=false` — Previews changes in the intended initialized root without refreshing resources or locking state. From [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md).
- `terraform fmt -check -recursive terraform/` — Runs the Terraform formatting check used in CI. From [.github/workflows/static_analysis.yml](.github/workflows/static_analysis.yml).
- `python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts/tests -p 'test_tf_apply_workspaces.py'` — Checks workspace selection and apply grouping. From [.github/workflows/static_analysis.yml](.github/workflows/static_analysis.yml).
- `python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts/tests -p 'test_nomad_iso_install.py'` — Checks Nomad ISO installation and rollout safeguards. From [.github/workflows/static_analysis.yml](.github/workflows/static_analysis.yml).
- `python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts/tests -p 'test_sentry_release.py'` — Checks Sentry release registration. From [.github/workflows/static_analysis.yml](.github/workflows/static_analysis.yml).
- `python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts/tests -p 'test_sentry_privacy.py'` — Checks Sentry privacy configuration. From [.github/workflows/static_analysis.yml](.github/workflows/static_analysis.yml).
- `python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts/tests -p 'test_container_os_ignore.py'` — Checks container OS drift behavior using offline provider plans. From [.github/workflows/static_analysis.yml](.github/workflows/static_analysis.yml).
- `python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts/tests -p 'test_airflow_gcs_iam_url.py'` — Checks Airflow logging and GCS IAM bucket URL handling. From [.github/workflows/static_analysis.yml](.github/workflows/static_analysis.yml).
- `python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts/tests -p 'test_airflow_shutdown.py'` — Checks Airflow graceful shutdown behavior. From [.github/workflows/static_analysis.yml](.github/workflows/static_analysis.yml).
- `python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts/tests -p 'test_nomad_app_disconnect.py'` — Runs the Nomad app Terraform suite and validates rendered disconnect jobs with initialized providers and Nomad 2.1.1. From [.github/workflows/static_analysis.yml](.github/workflows/static_analysis.yml).
- `python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts/tests -p 'test_deadlock_lake_sync.py'` — Checks rendered Deadlock lake-sync jobs with Nomad on PATH. From [.github/workflows/static_analysis.yml](.github/workflows/static_analysis.yml).
- `python3 -m unittest discover -s terraform/environments/va1/observability/nomad/jobs/alerts -p 'test_*.py'` — Tests backup alerts and runtime PromQL with Nomad and promtool. From [.github/workflows/static_analysis.yml](.github/workflows/static_analysis.yml).
- `python3 terraform/environments/va1/observability/nomad/jobs/alerts/gen_alerts.py` — Regenerates alert YAML that CI compares with the checked-in files. From [.github/workflows/static_analysis.yml](.github/workflows/static_analysis.yml).
- `python3 scripts/infra-ownership check` — Checks that the ownership manifest and generated CODEOWNERS agree. From [.github/workflows/static_analysis.yml](.github/workflows/static_analysis.yml).
- `bash terraform/environments/runpod/scripts/test-bootstrap.sh` — Tests Runpod bootstrap supervision, authentication, readiness failures, and retained state with mocked services. From [.github/workflows/static_analysis.yml](.github/workflows/static_analysis.yml).
- `bash terraform/environments/runpod/scripts/test-python-tools.sh` — Runs Runpod Python tooling regression checks. From [.github/workflows/static_analysis.yml](.github/workflows/static_analysis.yml).
- `node terraform/environments/va1/media-apps-dev/tests/test-media-worker-plan.mjs` — Checks media-worker authentication and storage plans with the initialized dev root and Nomad on PATH. From [.github/workflows/static_analysis.yml](.github/workflows/static_analysis.yml).
- `images/media-emisar-runner/test-image.sh "${TEST_IMAGE}"` — Tests the built media Emisar runner image using Docker. From [.github/workflows/docker-image-media-emisar-runner.yml](.github/workflows/docker-image-media-emisar-runner.yml).
- `images/postgres-pgbackrest/test-image.sh "${TEST_IMAGE}" "${BASE_IMAGE}"` — Tests the built PostgreSQL pgBackRest image against its base image using Docker. From [.github/workflows/docker-image-postgres-pgbackrest.yml](.github/workflows/docker-image-postgres-pgbackrest.yml).
- `./scripts/app ssh` — Selects a GCP VM with fzf and connects through IAP using operator credentials. From [README.md](README.md).
- `./scripts/app logs` — Selects GCP application VMs and reads logs through IAP. From [README.md](README.md).
- `./scripts/va1 db` — Selects a VA1 PostgreSQL allocation and opens a loopback-only database tunnel using host credentials. From [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md).
- `scripts/test-cloud-init <template> <vars_file>` — Renders and validates a cloud-init template using Docker. From [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md).

## Deploy and release

- Application repositories open pull requests to update shared tenant image versions. From [README.md](README.md).
- Pull requests to main run speculative HCP plans for workspaces selected by changed paths. The workflow gate requires successful selected plans. From [.github/workflows/tf-plan.yml](.github/workflows/tf-plan.yml).
- Check the detector when changing shared modules. It maps paths to consumers and omits nodes, Cassandra, AWS, and Runpod from automated workspace selection. From [.github/workflows/_tf-detect.yml](.github/workflows/_tf-detect.yml).
- Pushes to main apply selected workspaces through HCP. Applies serialize per workspace. For deployments outside the media queue, the runner keeps the current apply and newest pending apply. From [.github/workflows/_tf-run.yml](.github/workflows/_tf-run.yml).
- The media queue retains pending runs. A selected gcp-tenant-media apply must succeed before selected dev or prod app applies. App-only changes can run without a GCP apply. From [.github/workflows/tf-apply.yml](.github/workflows/tf-apply.yml).
- Apply va1-nodes manually from an operator machine with tailnet access, xorriso, Docker, OpenSSL, and documented credentials. ISO rollout requires explicit rollout flags. From [terraform/environments/va1/nodes/README.md](terraform/environments/va1/nodes/README.md).
- Apply Cassandra manually. ISO staging and rollout are separate operator steps. Verify node health before explicitly rolling BMC media and power changes. From [terraform/environments/va1/cassandra/README.md](terraform/environments/va1/cassandra/README.md).
- Review the environment runbooks for manual GPU deployments. For Runpod, configure HCP inputs, registry authentication and enrollment, review capacity and storage risks, and verify authenticated runtime readiness after deployment. From [terraform/environments/runpod/README.md](terraform/environments/runpod/README.md).
- Dispatch Promote media production from main to copy selected dev pins or use an exact single-service SHA override. The deployment App commits to main and triggers Terraform Apply. From [.github/workflows/promote-media.yml](.github/workflows/promote-media.yml).
- Dispatch runner image publication from main with publishing enabled. Deploy the immutable digest from the workflow summary after the image tests and vulnerability checks pass. From [images/media-emisar-runner/README.md](images/media-emisar-runner/README.md).
- Provision the registry and publisher identity, dispatch PostgreSQL publication from main with publish=true, and update Terraform to the tested digest. Use pgvector=true for the media variant and follow the extension upgrade instructions for existing databases. From [images/postgres-pgbackrest/README.md](images/postgres-pgbackrest/README.md).
- Airflow DAG releases advance the source ref matching the deployed runtime tag for git-sync to pick up. Dockerfile changes publish a new image and matching ref, then update the Terraform pin for graceful VM replacement. The initial rollout requires the matching artifact, ref, and read-only deploy credential before the infra pin goes live. From [terraform/environments/gcp/tenant/AIRFLOW_DEPLOYMENTS.md](terraform/environments/gcp/tenant/AIRFLOW_DEPLOYMENTS.md).

## Conventions

- Use `Component: concise change` for commit subjects and PR titles under the documented commit and PR guidance, for example `Cassandra: widen heap`. The example uses a capitalized component followed by a colon and space. Reference tracking issues and list required manual steps. The guidance leaves scope parentheses and issue-reference syntax unspecified. From [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md).
- Observed in recent commits, not a documented requirement: Recent non-merge subjects use capitalized prefixes such as `Sentry:` and `Airflow:` with a colon and space, commonly ending in `(#number)`. The suffix is an observed habit. Examples: `Sentry: grant tmiller overlay-service team access (#1596)`; `Airflow: enable BigQuery registration and Metabase reads (#1586)`; `Sentry: add overlay-service project with IP scrubbing (#1594)`.
- Observed in recent commits, not a documented requirement: Observed deployment subjects use lowercase `deploy:`, then the service, `dev`, the full image SHA, and a trailing `(#number)`. This is a release habit. Examples: `deploy: media-web dev d24027b6ebb6a62bb423516cf3cf140a19dd4e37 (#1595)`; `deploy: media-server dev 14f832ea2a7195d4c2b087dda14d9b9e4191a3aa (#1591)`; `deploy: media-admin dev 9b4a9d0fff675ca4b646d4bf4942ba5b751a664b (#1590)`.
- Observed in recent commits, not a documented requirement: Observed version-update subjects use `Bump <variable_name> to <image SHA>` without a colon prefix, sometimes followed by `(#number)`. This is a version-update habit. Examples: `Bump airflow_image_tag to a8db9209271a40cd061ab3347087097ecdcfa5dc`; `Bump airflow_image_tag to b27ef4c6b832ee8ec76ebac006a92aa6c5b02d0d`; `Bump website_image_tag to 4c2bc691832ebfc9234d0ba822855f1a447b5b10 (#1576)`.
- With core.hooksPath set to .githooks and Terraform installed, the pre-commit hook checks formatting for staged .tf paths. From [.githooks/pre-commit](.githooks/pre-commit).
- The prepare-commit-msg hook delegates to an executable external Coop hook when present. Its behavior depends on the local installation. From [.githooks/prepare-commit-msg](.githooks/prepare-commit-msg).
- Use the existing Coop queue for larger or resumable changes. Claim before editing and archive completed, committed work. Use the nearest owning subproject queue or the root queue for cross-cutting work. From [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md).
- Keep task context and acceptance criteria in task.md, the short resume checkpoint in state.md, and the append-only decision journal in log.md. From [.agent/tasks/README.md](.agent/tasks/README.md).
- Check provider and resource documentation, pin new providers in versions.tf, and prefer local modules where they support the configuration. From [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md).
- Use snake_case resource names, prefer for_each for collections whose middle entries may be removed, and order blocks as variable, locals, resource, data, output. From [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md).
- Before each commit, pass scripts/tf-check fmt, validate each changed environment, and run Terraform tests where present. Use the helper in agent boxes and keep incidental Linux lock-file checksums out of commits. From [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md).
- Operators control Terraform applies. Terraform state mutations require explicit approval. From [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md).
- Shell scripts require `set -euo pipefail`. Use IAP for GCP VM access and keep database tunnels loopback-only. From [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md).
- Keep secrets out of commits and use sensitive HCP Terraform variables or Google Secret Manager references. From [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md).
- Use managed_by=terraform, powered_by for application runtime, component_type for third-party components, and part_of for application grouping. From [README.md](README.md).
- Change the ownership manifest and generated CODEOWNERS together. Follow the documented product ownership and review boundaries for shared changes and scoped App publication. From [.github/ownership.md](.github/ownership.md).
- Update PostgreSQL or pgBackRest Dockerfile pins and their README together. Keep the last published pgBackRest digest until its replacement is published and deploy using immutable digests. From [images/postgres-pgbackrest/README.md](images/postgres-pgbackrest/README.md).

## Where to look

- Change a tenant application job: [terraform/environments/va1/tenant-apps/](terraform/environments/va1/tenant-apps/)
- Review CS2 worker storage, activation, or pausing: [terraform/environments/va1/tenant-apps/CS2_PIPELINE_MIGRATION.md](terraform/environments/va1/tenant-apps/CS2_PIPELINE_MIGRATION.md)
- Bump shared tenant application versions: [terraform/versions/](terraform/versions/)
- Change media development workloads or image pins: [terraform/environments/va1/media-apps-dev/](terraform/environments/va1/media-apps-dev/)
- Promote media to production: [.github/workflows/promote-media.yml](.github/workflows/promote-media.yml)
- Change reusable Nomad workload behavior: [terraform/modules/nomad/](terraform/modules/nomad/)
- Change Pure storage provisioning or snapshots: [terraform/modules/pure/](terraform/modules/pure/)
- Change host installation templates: [terraform/modules/bare-metal/](terraform/modules/bare-metal/)
- Review manual cluster rollout prerequisites: [terraform/environments/va1/nodes/README.md](terraform/environments/va1/nodes/README.md)
- Review Cassandra lifecycle, storage safety, or recovery: [terraform/environments/va1/cassandra/README.md](terraform/environments/va1/cassandra/README.md)
- Change dashboards or generated alert rules: [terraform/environments/va1/observability/](terraform/environments/va1/observability/)
- Change shared SuperTokens migration SQL: [terraform/environments/va1/scripts/](terraform/environments/va1/scripts/)
- Roll out Airflow code or runtime changes: [terraform/environments/gcp/tenant/AIRFLOW_DEPLOYMENTS.md](terraform/environments/gcp/tenant/AIRFLOW_DEPLOYMENTS.md)
- Review Airflow registrar and Metabase BigQuery permissions: [terraform/environments/gcp/tenant/BIGQUERY_REGISTRAR.md](terraform/environments/gcp/tenant/BIGQUERY_REGISTRAR.md)
- Enable or recover tenant Metabase: [terraform/environments/va1/analytics/tenant_METABASE.md](terraform/environments/va1/analytics/tenant_METABASE.md)
- Manage Sentry projects or verify overlay-service privacy settings: [terraform/environments/sentry/README.md](terraform/environments/sentry/README.md)
- Change public DNS: [terraform/environments/cloudflare/](terraform/environments/cloudflare/)
- Change tailnet team SSH access or Runpod enrollment: [terraform/environments/tailscale/tenant/](terraform/environments/tailscale/tenant/)
- Debug workspace selection in CI: [.github/workflows/_tf-detect.yml](.github/workflows/_tf-detect.yml)
- Find operator and deployment script regression tests: [scripts/tests/](scripts/tests/)

## Open questions

- Which prepared ownership, scoped release, and workflow-publication policies are installed and verified in live GitHub settings?
- The Tailscale README calls for manual approval, while CI selects its workspace for merge-driven applies. Which approval path governs routine changes?
- The root README singles out nodes as the manual exception, while the detector also omits Cassandra, AWS, and Runpod.
- The checkout shows no commit-subject or PR-title syntax check. Does the externally installed Coop message hook add any local requirement?
